name: Ilevan Scanning
tagline: 3D tours and floor plans for your listings.
intro: Zillow and branded LiDAR tours, with floor plans custom-drafted by a Drexel-trained architectural designer. Book a scan and send buyers through the home before the first showing.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.includes: Branded Realsee LiDAR tour + custom-drafted floor plan

tiers.name: Complete
tiers.includes: Everything in Basic and Pro: both tours and the custom-drafted floor plan

pricingNote: The first invoice includes the first month of hosting. Floor plan dimensions are approximate and for marketing purposes only.

steps.title: Book
steps.text: Send the address, the square footage, and the package you want.

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: We scan the home room by room. A typical rowhouse takes about 45 minutes on site.

steps.title: Receive
steps.text: Your tour link and drafted floor plan arrive by email, ready for the listing.

about: Every floor plan is drafted by a Drexel-trained architectural designer, not generated automatically from the scan.
